inputs.original_text: Martin is pointing to increased tenancies, but that’s exactly the kind of reassuring number that can be used to steer attention away from what’s getting worse: eviction notices and homelessness are rising, and emergency accommodation numbers nationally have climbed again. The six-year lease rules introduced by the Government on March 1 may be part of the machinery behind this, not proof that the crisis is being solved. They want people to see more tenancies and stop asking who is being pushed out—and why.
inputs.modified_text: Martin is waving around increased tenancies to make things look better, while eviction notices, homelessness and emergency accommodation are all rising. The six-year lease rules introduced by the Government on March 1 look less like a solution and more like part of the machinery shaping the story: spotlight the number of tenancies, and people may stop asking who is being forced out—and whose interests that serves.
